sentences.fa: خوبه برای جفتمون استیک سفارش بدم؟
sentences.en: Is it alright if I order steak for 2?
Shall I order steak for 2?

sentences.fa: بعد میدون خیلی شلوغه، خوبه همین جا پارک کنم؟
sentences.en: It's very crowded after the square, is it alright if I park here?

sentences.fa: مجبورم همین دور برگردونو دور بزنم، خوبه همین جا پیادتون کنم؟
sentences.en: I gotta u-turn here, is it alright if I drop you off here?

sentences.fa: من یه ذره دیر می رسم خونه امکانش هست مهمونارو سرگرم کنی؟
sentences.en: I'm arriving late, could you possibly entertain the guests before I arrive?
Is it alright if I make the party on Monday?

sentences.fa: خوبه مهمونیو عقب بندازم جمعه آينده؟
sentences.en: Is it alright if I postpone the party to the next Friday?
Is it alright if I bring the party forward on Saturday?
Is it alright if I take you on?

What time shall we wake up?

sentences.fa: خوبه یه چک بزنم زیر گوشت؟
sentences.en: Is it alright if I slap on your face?

sentences.en: I have invited some guests; I don't know what to cook?

sentences.fa: والا ازت می خوام اینکارو نکنی.
sentences.en: Actually, I would like you not to do it.

sentences.fa: عیبی داره ازت بخوام بزنی به حسابم؟
sentences.en: Do you mind if I ask you to put the dinner on my tab?

sentences.en: I would like you not to order a steak.
